invariants.rationale: After assignment, the container's background field should equal the background parameter.
If padding was meant to be adjusted, the background field must be up to date.
drawable dimensions should be non-negative if a background is present, as commonly required by UI layout constraints.
If adjustPadding is true and background is non-null, its dimensions should be non-negative.
When no adjustment is requested, the only effect is setting the background field.
